kurz: Cut potatoes release starch into the water, and you can even see it.
bild_im_kopf: Like flour dust settling in a glass: what floated invisibly in the water slowly sinks to the bottom.
beobachtung: The water is cloudy, and a white layer settles at the bottom of the glass.
erklaerung: That is starch that fell out of the cells when cutting. Rinsed off, it no longer sticks to the surface, which is why soaked chips turn crispier.
schritte: Cut a potato into sticks and put them in water.
After 30 minutes take the sticks out.
Pour the water into a glass and leave it for an hour.
